name: shift-mcp-server
description: Lightweight coordination layer for multiple AI agents working on the same codebase simultaneously.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight coordination layer for multiple AI agents working on the same codebase simultaneously.
interface.longDescription: Check agents in and out of a workspace-scoped SQLite roster shared across local processes. Configure a common SHIFT_WORKSPACE and state directory. Each check-in returns coordination instructions, active peers, and a qualified statusUri. Sessions persist until check-out. Modern listeners receive mutations committed in their server process; poll to observe commits from other processes or through the framework's legacy adapter.
